phase.name: Phase E kickoff
phase.goal: Transition from D-phase control rehearsals into promotion-gated canary rollout execution and automated rollback governance.

entry_criteria: Phase-D pull request includes D1, D2, and D3 implementation commits with passing targeted quality gates.
Rollout rehearsal protocol exists and executes deterministically with machine-readable evidence.

priority_work_items.title: Promote rollout rehearsal to CI release gate
priority_work_items.problem_statement: D3 rehearsal artifacts are available, but CI does not yet block merges on failed drill outcomes or rollback recommendations.
scope: Fail CI when rollout_rehearsal_report.json overall_status is FAILED.
Fail CI when rollback_recommendations is non-empty.
Persist rollout rehearsal report as CI artifact for operator review.
acceptance_criteria: CI executes rollout rehearsal checks on each relevant pull request.
Merge is blocked when rehearsal drills fail or rollback recommendations are emitted.
CI output includes deterministic artifact path for rehearsal report inspection.

priority_work_items.title: Automate rollout pre-check and post-check bundles
priority_work_items.problem_statement: Protocol command bundles are documented, but operator execution is still manual and not yet auditable as a single deterministic gate.
scope: Add a command-bundle runner that executes protocol precheck_commands and postcheck_commands.
Emit structured command execution report with command, exit code, and failure reasons.
Integrate bundle report references into rollout rehearsal output.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-check and post-check commands can be executed in one deterministic invocation.
Any failed command becomes a rollout-blocking signal in generated report metadata.
Bundle execution report is reproducible and suitable for operator handoff.

priority_work_items.title: Canary rollout readiness certification and promotion criteria
priority_work_items.problem_statement: D3 rollback matrix exists, but phase promotion still lacks explicit readiness scoring and canary-stage certification artifact.
scope: Define canary promotion criteria artifact keyed to rehearsal outcomes and runtime control evidence.
Add readiness scoring and fail-fast blockers for unresolved rollback signals.
Document phase-promotion ownership and manual approval boundary for canary enablement.
acceptance_criteria: Certification artifact reports PASS/FAIL with criterion-level reason codes.
Promotion to canary stage is blocked when any critical/high rollback trigger remains unresolved.
Operator runbook specifies explicit approval and rollback authority path.

handoff_notes: Preserve current pull request stream for phase integration visibility while Phase E tasks begin.
Use short-lived feature branches under feat/poly-robot-phase-e-* for isolated E-workstreams.
Treat non-empty rollback_recommendations as rollout blockers requiring explicit remediation before promotion.
